_comment: Meyers Building Group, Bowral NSW. Hand-written 2026-09-24 from https://meyersbuildinggroup.com.au because `npm run new` is broken in this container (see HANDOVER.md). Every page of their GoDaddy site was read with curl. Their site names no person and no town, so the owner's name (Darren Meyers) comes from the ABR trading names on their ABN, and Bowral from the ABR postcode and their Yellow Pages listing. No Google rating or reviews exist (data/google_reviews_top25.json), and there are no testimonials on their site, so reviews is empty and the proof is their own sourced facts: 80% returning clients and referrals, over 30 years, fully licensed and insured, and their registered ABN. The builders preset's process, FAQ and responsePromise describe a generic builder and would be invented claims here, so all three are overridden with lines from their own site. 7 of the 8 photos are their own (one job), upscaled 2x with Real-ESRGAN because the originals are 960px wide; the earth moving tile is a labelled CC0 sample. No stats strip: the only number available is 'over 30 years', which the owner section already shows as 30+, and a lone stat left a large empty band on desktop. No serviceAreas: their site lists no suburbs, and inventing Highlands towns would be unsourced. See BRIEF.md.

photos._comment: 8 photos. 7 are Meyers Building Group's own, all from their Project Gallery (img1.wsimg.com/isteam/ip/7811a3ed-98ba-483b-8a43-fd6e5038d34b/), all showing one property. The originals are 960px wide (855px for the garage), so each was upscaled 2x with Real-ESRGAN x2plus, a proper AI upscaler, never more than 2x. Each appears once: hero, 2 service tiles, 4 gallery. The check needs 3 services, so the earth moving tile uses 1 labelled CC0 sample (they have no photo of their own machine). Their site doesn't name the suburb of this job, so no caption does. Left out: a black-and-white duplicate of the garage photo and three black-and-white GoDaddy template stock images (excavators, a man at a bathtub). No statement or aperture photo: there aren't enough distinct photos, so those sections are off.

stockApproved.reason: All 7 of their own photos are used once each (hero, 2 service tiles, 4 gallery). The check needs 3 services, and they have no photo of their earth moving work, so that one tile uses a labelled CC0 sample.

faq.q: Do you take on smaller jobs?
faq.a: Yes. As well as new homes and extensions, we build decks and pergolas, and renovate single kitchens and bathrooms.

faq.q: Can you keep the heritage features?
faq.a: Yes. In a kitchen we can modernise, or keep the heritage elements. We also restore rundown and unfinished projects and make them new again.

faq.q: Can you add a granny flat?
faq.a: Yes. An extension can add rooms, a bathroom, a kitchen or more living space, and we can add a granny flat to your home.

faq.q: Can you prepare the site as well?
faq.a: Yes. When a job needs some preparation, our own earth moving service moves the earth and rubble first, and then we build.
Yes. We build or renovate the space your business runs from: offices, warehouses and retail spaces.

faq.q: Can we meet outside business hours?
faq.a: We work flexible hours to meet with you about what you need, and we're happy to come out to the site to talk it through.
